# World News API

The World News API gives you access to thousands of news sources in over 50 languages from over 150 countries.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/world-news-api/.

## Actions

- **Extract News** (read-only): Extract a news article from a website to a well-structured JSON object.
- **Get Top News** (read-only): Get the top news from a country in a specific language for a given date.
- **Search News Sources** (read-only): Search whether a news source is being monitored by the World News API.
- **Extract News Links** (read-only): Extract news article links from a website or webpage.
- **Get Geo Coordinates** (read-only): Retrieve latitude and longitude of a location name.
- **News Website to RSS Feed** (read-only): Convert any news website page into an RSS feed.
